note: Actual export shipments are documented, not merely claimed: dated India customs export records with destination (UAE, Hong Kong), HS 71131911 and bill-of-lading numbers, latest visible 2025-08-08 (HS 71181000 silver medallions to Dubai). Declared HS 711319 matches the observed export HS 71131911 (gold jewellery) — no HS correction needed. Industry claim 'Продукты питания и FMCG' is contradicted by the shipment data: the company ships plain gold/silver jewellery, i.e. gems & jewellery, not food/FMCG; this is a profile-field error, not a rejection ground. Note the two ImportKey slugs appear to be the same entity at the same Delhi address (Reghar Pura) with 12 and 2 records respectively; the 2025-08-05 row is an import, not an export. Domestic (intra-India) supply evidence could not be checked because registry sites blocked access and search was down — recorded as unknown, not as 'no supplies found'. No revenue or export-volume figures are public in the free views, so both remain null.
